items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: I played a parade with John and they walked up and asked me

ctx.x: Where did you get that vega banjo?

Uh, he probably gave it to one of us. Oh, John Bernard gave it to one of us? That's right. One of the time, him and some other people came. I played a parade with John and they walked up and asked me, said, we went to two of the great banjo. I said, I did. He said, would you want one to come back? I said, yeah, I'll tell you. I thought he was joking. Went by his house and picked up the banjo. I said, I'm a father out there. But the trouble is, they got a ring. Now you can't get a break on a banjo. If you're not…
Oh no, you have to be in the city.
